scope_note: Permit-specific preflight checks compiled from current official application instructions, ordinances, information bulletins, utility rules, and state program guidance. Incorporated technical codes remain controlling for design details.

application_identity.title: Project address and record identity
application_identity.requirement: The application address, parcel, project name, and related parent record must identify the same project and location.

application_identity.title: Consistent scope of work
application_identity.requirement: The application scope must agree with the drawings, specifications, calculations, and related permit records; unexplained scope differences must be flagged.
application_identity.citation: IB110 Part A, plan preparation and resubmittal requirements

commercial_plan_common.title: Design professional in responsible charge
commercial_plan_common.requirement: Identify the design professional in responsible charge and verify coordination of architectural, structural, MEP, deferred, and resubmitted documents.

commercial_plan_common.title: Complete legible PDF plan package
commercial_plan_common.requirement: Plans must be legible electronic PDFs, grouped as a complete set or by discipline, clearly named, and not marked preliminary or not for construction.

commercial_plan_common.title: Missouri professional seals
commercial_plan_common.requirement: Plans, specifications, calculations, soils reports, and drainage studies must bear the appropriate Missouri architect or engineer seal; discipline and incidental-practice limits must be respected.

commercial_plan_common.title: Complete site plan and sealed survey when triggered
commercial_plan_common.requirement: The site plan must show legal description, property lines, utilities, hydrants, service connections, backflow devices, and floodplain information. New structures, additions, and exterior-envelope changes require a sealed land survey.
commercial_plan_common.citation: IB110 Part A, p. 3; KCMO Plans Review sealed-survey notice

commercial_plan_common.title: Code and energy analysis
commercial_plan_common.requirement: The first three plan pages must include the applicable code analysis, with energy analysis sheets and special-inspection list when required.
commercial_plan_common.citation: IB110 Part A, p. 3; IB110 Part C; IB171 Commercial

commercial_plan_common.title: Cross-discipline design consistency
commercial_plan_common.requirement: Occupancy, construction type, area, height, occupant load, egress, fire protection, structural grids, equipment, shafts, and utility locations must agree across all disciplines.
commercial_plan_common.citation: IB110 Parts A and C commercial plan checklist

commercial_plan_common.title: Deferred submittals identified
commercial_plan_common.requirement: Every deferred shop-design item must be listed and coordinated; a full building permit cannot issue until required deferred plans are received.
commercial_plan_common.citation: IB110 Part A, p. 2; IB110 Part D

commercial_plan_common.title: Complete coordinated resubmittal
commercial_plan_common.requirement: Each resubmittal must include a DPRC-signed response letter keyed to comments, full replacement discipline PDFs, revision clouds, and disclosure of unrelated changes.

trade_common.title: Licensed trade contractor
trade_common.requirement: Commercial and multifamily trade work must be permitted and performed by the appropriately licensed contractor.
trade_common.citation: KCMO trade permit process; Chapter 18 contractor licensing

trade_common.title: Approved parent plan or trade-only plan
trade_common.requirement: Verify the approved parent building plan and permit, or the approved trade-only plan route, before issuing the trade permit unless the documented scope qualifies for description-only review.
trade_common.citation: KCMO trade permit process, plan review and related-record workflow

trade_common.title: Trade scope matches approved plans
trade_common.requirement: Equipment, capacities, locations, schedules, risers, one-lines or isometrics, and scope description must agree with the approved building and trade drawings.
trade_common.citation: KCMO trade permit process; IB110 Part C

trade_common.title: Required inspections before concealment
trade_common.requirement: Identify required rough, test, service, final, and other trade inspections; work may not be concealed or occupied before required approvals.

public_infrastructure_common.title: Approved infrastructure plans
public_infrastructure_common.requirement: Development Services plan review must approve the applicable infrastructure construction plans before the permit application proceeds.
public_infrastructure_common.citation: KCMO Major Infrastructure permit process; IB159

public_infrastructure_common.title: Permittee matches approved plans
public_infrastructure_common.requirement: The developer or owner named as permittee must match the approved plans, or the assigned reviewer must approve the change.

public_infrastructure_common.title: Required liability insurance
public_infrastructure_common.requirement: Verify at least $1,000,000 general liability coverage, required additional insured parties, and the City certificate-holder wording.

public_infrastructure_common.title: Required bond or financial security
public_infrastructure_common.requirement: Provide the city-approved performance, maintenance, combined bond, letter of credit, or payment in lieu when requested for the improvement type and valuation.

public_infrastructure_common.title: Authorized agent documentation
public_infrastructure_common.requirement: If an agent obtains the permit, both parties must be registered in CompassKC and the signed Authorized Agent Form must be attached.

public_infrastructure_common.title: Revised permit for approved plan changes
public_infrastructure_common.requirement: Construction changes must be discussed with the inspector, approved by the plan reviewer, and incorporated into a revised permit with updated security or fees when requested.
public_infrastructure_common.citation: KCMO Major Infrastructure, Changes to Approved Plans

row_common.title: Correct right-of-way activity permit
row_common.requirement: Select the permit that exactly matches excavation, traffic control, hauling, loading, street plate, dumpster, encroachment, or streetcar activity in public right-of-way.
row_common.citation: KCMO Public Works Permit Applications; Chapter 64

row_common.title: Work-zone location plan
row_common.requirement: Show the exact right-of-way limits, affected assets, dimensions, restoration, pedestrian route, traffic impacts, and dates.
row_common.citation: KCMO Public Works and Minor Infrastructure application requirements

row_common.title: Insurance and responsible contractor
row_common.requirement: Verify the responsible applicant or contractor, current insurance, and any license or authorization required for the work.
row_common.citation: KCMO Public Works permit process; Development Services insurance requirements

row_common.title: Restoration and accessibility details
row_common.requirement: Plans must preserve or restore pavement, curb, sidewalk, ADA access, utilities, and public safety in accordance with the approved details and permit conditions.

water_common.title: Permit before water-service work
water_common.requirement: No tapping, connection, alteration, repair, replacement, or extension may begin before the applicable KC Water permit is issued.
water_common.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, sec. 1.3; Chapter 78

water_common.title: Qualified water-service applicant
water_common.requirement: Verify the applicant is a licensed master plumber, eligible fire sprinkler contractor, authorized city contractor, or eligible demolition contractor for the exact permit class.

water_common.title: KC Water accounts and permits current
water_common.requirement: Property accounts, fees, job orders, and prior permit corrections must be current before issuance.
water_common.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, secs. 1.0 and 1.8-1.9

water_common.title: Approved sealed commercial water plans
water_common.requirement: Commercial connection plans must be signed and sealed by a Missouri professional engineer and accepted by KC Water; the building permit must be available when applicable.
water_common.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, secs. 1.11-1.12; IB110 Part B

water_common.title: Public Works excavation permit
water_common.requirement: Obtain the Public Works excavation permit when water or sewer work enters or cuts public right-of-way.
water_common.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, sec. 1.11; KCMO Public Works

water_common.title: KC Water inspection before concealment
water_common.requirement: Schedule required KC Water inspections and do not conceal, backfill, place in service, or complete the connection before approval.
water_common.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, sec. 7; 2026 Sewer Service Line Rules

fire_system_common.title: Adopted fire-code design basis
fire_system_common.requirement: Identify the adopted KCMO fire code and referenced NFPA standard used for the system; design criteria must match the building occupancy, construction, hazard, and approved code analysis.
fire_system_common.citation: KCMO Chapter 26; IB110 Part B fire review

fire_system_common.title: Missouri fire-protection design seal
fire_system_common.requirement: Fire-protection design documents must bear a Missouri engineer seal; shop drawings prepared by a NICET Level III technician require engineer-of-record review and acceptance stamp when that path is used.

fire_system_common.title: Related building record and approved design criteria
fire_system_common.requirement: Link the fire-system record to the building permit and verify occupancy, construction type, fire-protection approach, water supply, and related life-safety design are approved.
fire_system_common.citation: IB110 Parts A-B; CompassKC related-record workflow

fire_system_common.title: Complete system drawings and product data
fire_system_common.requirement: Provide system layout, calculations, risers or one-lines, device and equipment schedules, sequence or operating narrative, and listed product data applicable to the system.
fire_system_common.citation: KCMO Chapter 26 and adopted fire standards; IB110 Part C

fire_system_common.title: Fire-system coordination
fire_system_common.requirement: System drawings must agree with architectural reflected ceilings, room uses, rated construction, egress, structural supports, electrical power, mechanical controls, and other fire systems.

fire_system_common.title: Acceptance testing and final approval
fire_system_common.requirement: Document required inspections, acceptance tests, integrated tests, certificates, and final fire approval before occupancy.
fire_system_common.citation: KCMO Chapter 26; certificate-of-occupancy final approval requirements

occupancy_common.title: Approved use and occupancy
occupancy_common.requirement: The requested use, occupancy classification, tenant, address, suite, and occupied area must match approved zoning and building records.

occupancy_common.title: All required final inspections approved
occupancy_common.requirement: Building, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, fire/life-safety, accessibility, elevator, site, and other required finals must be approved or explicitly deferred under an authorized temporary occupancy.

occupancy_common.title: Built conditions match approved plans
occupancy_common.requirement: Occupant load, exits, accessibility, plumbing fixtures, fire systems, equipment, and tenant layout must match approved plans and field conditions.

occupancy_common.title: Corrections, holds, and fees resolved
occupancy_common.requirement: Resolve open corrections, permit holds, required revisions, inspection failures, and applicable fees before occupancy approval.

rules.title: Sealed land survey when construction triggers it
rules.requirement: For a new structure, addition, or exterior-envelope change, require the current sealed land survey and verify existing and proposed construction and property lines are shown.
rules.citation: KCMO Plans Review sealed-survey notice; IB110 Part A, p. 3

question.label: Does the project add a structure, addition, or change the exterior building envelope?

rules.title: Parcel legal description reconciliation
rules.requirement: The legal description and parcel identifiers must agree across the survey, deed or owner record, application, tax/parcel data, and site plan; flag any discrepancy.
rules.citation: IB110 Part A site-plan requirements; Chapter 88 application completeness

rules.title: Official base zoning district
rules.requirement: The zoning district printed on the plans and application must match the current official KCMO GIS/Parcel Viewer result and any parcel-specific ordinance.
rules.citation: KCMO Zoning Verification; Chapter 88 official district standards

rules.title: Overlay and special-status inventory
rules.requirement: List and reconcile every mapped overlay, special character district, local historic designation, approved variance, special/conditional use, and active controlling development approval.
rules.citation: KCMO Zoning Compliance Letter contents; Chapter 88

rules.title: Historic approval dependency
rules.requirement: If the property is locally listed and exterior work is proposed, require the Certificate of Appropriateness before the building permit can issue.
rules.citation: IB110 Part B, Historic Preservation review

rules.title: Proposed use authorization
rules.requirement: Classify the proposed use and verify it is allowed by right or supported by the required special use, variance, legal-nonconformance record, or approved development plan.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 use tables and approval procedures; KCMO Zoning Verification

question.label: What exact business or land use will occupy the property?

rules.title: Building height compliance
rules.requirement: Calculate proposed height under Chapter 88 measurement rules and compare it with the controlling base district, overlay, airport, variance, ordinance, or approved-plan limit.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 district and measurement standards

question.label: What is the proposed building height in feet?

rules.title: Floor area ratio compliance
rules.requirement: Calculate FAR from gross floor area and lot area and compare it with the controlling district or approved development plan when FAR applies.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 base-district dimensional standards

question.label: What is the proposed total gross floor area?

rules.title: Setback and build-to compliance
rules.requirement: Compare every proposed setback and applicable build-to line with the base district, overlay, downtown-loop rule, platted building line, and approved development plan.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 district, downtown development, and measurement standards

rules.title: Downtown facade transparency
rules.requirement: When the site is within the Chapter 88 downtown-loop applicability area, verify required street-facing transparency, including the 60 percent primary-street standard between 4 and 10 feet above the sidewalk and applicable secondary-street treatment.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 sec. 88-338-01-B

question.label: Is the project inside the Chapter 88 downtown-loop applicability boundary?

rules.title: Downtown street-facing entrance
rules.requirement: When downtown-loop standards apply, verify a working public entrance faces the street or qualifying corner and agrees with the site and floor plans.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 sec. 88-338-01-C

rules.title: Applicable blank-wall and facade-articulation limits
rules.requirement: Check blank-wall length, wall-plane articulation, entry frequency, transparency, and facade-composition limits from every controlling overlay, approved development plan, parcel ordinance, and adopted area-specific standard. Do not apply a universal 20-foot blank-wall limit when the controlling law does not contain one.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 applicable overlay and approved-development-plan standards; KCMO Zoning Verification

rules.title: Vehicle parking calculation
rules.requirement: Calculate required and maximum parking from current use, floor area or units, exemptions, reductions, shared arrangements, and the statutory Downtown Streetcar Area; compare with the site plan.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 sec. 88-420

question.label: How many off-street vehicle parking spaces are proposed?

rules.title: Bicycle parking calculation
rules.requirement: Calculate short- and long-term bicycle parking under current Chapter 88 requirements and compare counts, dimensions, location, security, and weather protection with the plans.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 sec. 88-420-09

question.label: How many short-term and long-term bicycle spaces are proposed?

rules.title: Loading berth calculation
rules.requirement: Calculate loading spaces from current use, gross floor area, and dwelling units, then verify count, access, and dimensions on the site plan.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 sec. 88-420-17

rules.title: Landscape and streetscape compliance
rules.requirement: When site or exterior work triggers landscaping, provide the required landscape/streetscape plan and verify planting, screening, buffers, parking-lot landscaping, and maintenance requirements.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 sec. 88-425; IB110 Part C

question.label: Does the project alter landscaping, streetscape, parking areas, or exterior site screening?

rules.title: Trash, recycling, and equipment screening
rules.requirement: Show containers and mechanical/utility equipment and verify location, access, enclosure, and screening under the applicable Chapter 88 standards.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 sec. 88-425-08

question.label: Will the project add or relocate exterior trash, recycling, mechanical, or utility equipment?

rules.title: Height and zoning values agree across documents
rules.requirement: Building height, floor area, lot area, setbacks, parking, use, and zoning labels must agree across the zoning cover sheet, survey, site plan, architectural elevations, code analysis, and application.
rules.citation: IB110 Parts A and C plan coordination requirements

rules.title: Professional seal validation
rules.requirement: Where professional design is required, verify the responsible Missouri architect, engineer, or land surveyor seal, license identity, discipline, signature, and date on the controlling document.
rules.citation: IB110 Part A, p. 2; KCMO sealed-survey requirement

rules.title: Domestic demand and meter sizing
rules.requirement: Calculate domestic demand, meter size, service-line size, pressure, and fixture demand and reconcile them with plumbing drawings and KC Water records.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules; IB110 Part C

rules.title: Service route and connection plan
rules.requirement: Show the public main, approved tap or connection, corporation stop, service route, meter setting, valves, easements, property line, separation, and restoration.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, design and installation requirements; Chapter 78

rules.title: Approved pipe, fittings, and installation
rules.requirement: Verify service material, size, joints, bedding, depth, tracer provisions, valves, meter setting, and installation method comply with the current KC Water rules.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules

rules.title: Water and sewer separation
rules.requirement: Water-service routing and elevations must maintain required separation from sanitary and storm sewers and agree across civil, plumbing, and utility plans.
rules.citation: 2026 Water and Sewer Service Line Rules

rules.title: Backflow protection dependency
rules.requirement: Identify the service hazard classification and provide the required approved backflow assembly, location, testing, and related permit before service activation.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, backflow requirements; Chapter 78

rules.title: Inspection, test, meter, and activation
rules.requirement: Complete required pressure or leakage tests, inspections, meter installation, account setup, corrections, and authorization before placing the service in use.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, inspection and service requirements

rules.title: Hydraulic demand and available supply
rules.requirement: Reconcile hydrant-flow or approved water-supply data, sprinkler and standpipe demand, hose allowance, fire-pump demand, and residual pressure with the proposed fire-service size.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules; Chapter 26; IB110 Part B

rules.title: Sealed fire-service connection plan
rules.requirement: Show main, connection, lead-in, valves, detector check or backflow assembly, vault or room, fire-department connection relationship, hydrants, easements, and property line on accepted plans.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules; IB110 Part C

rules.title: Eligible fire-service permit applicant
rules.requirement: Verify the exact underground scope is obtained and performed by a contractor eligible under KC Water rules and coordinated with the licensed fire-suppression contractor.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, sec. 1.10

rules.title: Backflow and detector assembly
rules.requirement: Verify assembly type, listing, size, access, drainage, freeze protection, bypass meter or detector, valves, and testing match KC Water and fire-system requirements.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules; Chapter 26 and adopted fire standards

rules.title: Fire service matches suppression plans
rules.requirement: Service size, point of connection, valve arrangement, backflow, fire pump, hydrants, and hydraulic inputs must agree across civil, utility, sprinkler, standpipe, pump, and building plans.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules; IB110 Part A; Chapter 26

rules.title: Flush, pressure test, inspection, and release
rules.requirement: Complete required underground inspection, flushing, pressure testing, certificates, corrections, and coordinated acceptance before connecting or activating the fire system.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules; Chapter 26 and adopted fire standards

rules.title: Sewer permit before connection work
rules.requirement: Obtain the applicable KC Water sewer-service permit before installing, replacing, repairing, reconnecting, or abandoning a building sewer.
rules.citation: 2026 Sewer Service Line Rules; Chapter 60

rules.title: Qualified sewer permit applicant
rules.requirement: Verify the permit holder and installer meet KC Water licensing and authorization requirements for the proposed sewer work.
rules.citation: 2026 Sewer Service Line Rules; Chapter 18 trade licensing

rules.title: Complete sewer-service plan
rules.requirement: Show connection point, pipe size/material/slope, cleanouts, property line, easements, existing services, utility conflicts, separation, bedding, and restoration.
rules.citation: 2026 Sewer Service Line Rules; IB110 Part C

rules.title: Discharge and system capacity
rules.requirement: Verify proposed fixture or process discharge, connection location, gravity elevations or pump design, and receiving-system conditions are accepted by KC Water.
rules.citation: 2026 Sewer Service Line Rules; Chapter 60

rules.title: Prohibited inflow and storm connections
rules.requirement: Confirm roof, area, foundation, sump, footing-drain, and stormwater discharges are not connected to the sanitary sewer unless specifically authorized.
rules.citation: 2026 Sewer Service Line Rules; Chapter 60

rules.title: Pretreatment and interceptor review
rules.requirement: Identify food-service, industrial, oil, grease, sand, chemical, or other process discharges and require the applicable pretreatment approval or interceptor details.
rules.citation: KC Water Industrial Pretreatment Program; Chapter 60

question.label: Will the project discharge grease, oil, sand, chemicals, manufacturing waste, or other non-domestic wastewater?

rules.title: Inspection and testing before backfill
rules.requirement: Complete required sewer inspections, tests, connection verification, corrections, and abandonment or capping inspections before concealment or backfill.
rules.citation: 2026 Sewer Service Line Rules

rules.title: Approved storm connection and drainage plan
rules.requirement: Obtain acceptance of the storm-drainage and public-system connection design before construction or connection.
rules.citation: Chapter 61; IB159; KCMO Major Infrastructure

rules.title: Hydrology and hydraulic calculations
rules.requirement: Provide sealed drainage-area mapping, existing and proposed runoff, design storms, pipe or channel capacity, hydraulic grade line, inlet calculations, and outfall analysis.
rules.citation: Chapter 61; IB110 Part A drainage-study requirements

rules.title: Storm-system construction plan
rules.requirement: Show inlets, manholes, pipe sizes/materials/slopes, profiles, structures, easements, utility conflicts, detention or treatment controls, outfall protection, and restoration.
rules.citation: Chapter 61; IB159

rules.title: Lawful discharge point and capacity
rules.requirement: Verify the receiving public system or outfall is lawful, has accepted capacity, and will not create adverse flooding, erosion, or illicit discharge.
rules.citation: Chapters 61 and 63

rules.title: Storm design matches site and grading plans
rules.requirement: Drainage areas, contours, finished floors, inlets, utilities, detention, overflow routes, and discharge points must agree across civil, landscape, utility, and building documents.
rules.citation: Chapter 61; IB110 Part A plan coordination

rules.title: Inspection, testing, and as-builts
rules.requirement: Complete required construction inspections, material or compaction tests, structure checks, correction work, record drawings, and acceptance before closeout.
rules.citation: KCMO Development Services inspections and infrastructure closeout

rules.title: Cross-connection hazard classification
rules.requirement: Classify each domestic, fire, irrigation, process, boiler, chemical, or other connection and select protection appropriate to the actual hazard.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules, backflow requirements; Chapter 78

rules.title: Approved assembly type and size
rules.requirement: Verify the selected assembly is approved, listed where required, correctly sized for demand and pressure loss, and assigned to the proper service.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules

rules.title: Accessible protected installation location
rules.requirement: Show assembly orientation, elevation, clearances, drainage, freeze and flood protection, lighting, access, valves, and prohibition on unapproved bypasses.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules; IB110 Part C

rules.title: Backflow details agree across disciplines
rules.requirement: Assembly type, size, service, location, meter, valves, drains, and equipment connections must agree across civil, plumbing, fire, irrigation, and mechanical plans.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules; IB110 Part A coordination

rules.title: Qualified test and certification
rules.requirement: Require testing and certification by personnel accepted under current KC Water requirements, with device serial number and test results tied to the correct address and service.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules

rules.title: Approval before service activation
rules.requirement: Complete installation inspection, test report, corrections, and KC Water acceptance before placing the protected service or connected equipment in operation.
rules.citation: 2026 Water Service Line Rules

rules.title: KC Water extension agreement and acceptance
rules.requirement: Complete the required developer, owner, or cost-participation process and obtain KC Water acceptance before construction.
rules.citation: 2025 Water Main Extension and Relocation Rules

rules.title: Sealed water-main construction plans
rules.requirement: Provide accepted Missouri-engineer-sealed plan/profile sheets, connections, valves, hydrants, services, easements, restraint, crossings, conflicts, restoration, notes, and standard details.
rules.citation: 2025 Water Main Extension Rules; IB159

rules.title: System capacity, pressure, and fire flow
rules.requirement: Demonstrate accepted sizing, looping, pressure, fire-flow, demand, and system-reliability performance for the development and surrounding system.
rules.citation: 2025 Water Main Extension Rules; Chapter 78

rules.title: Approved materials and installation details
rules.requirement: Verify pipe, fittings, valves, hydrants, joint restraint, corrosion protection, bedding, cover, separations, and construction methods match current KC Water standards.
rules.citation: 2025 Water Main Extension Rules

rules.title: Rights-of-way and utility easements
rules.requirement: Secure accepted permanent and temporary easements, access, encumbrance resolution, and recording for all facilities outside public right-of-way.
rules.citation: 2025 Water Main Extension Rules; KCMO infrastructure process

rules.title: Inspection, pressure test, disinfection, and acceptance
rules.requirement: Complete KC Water inspection, pressure and leakage tests, flushing, disinfection, bacteriological clearance, record drawings, and final acceptance before activation.
rules.citation: 2025 Water Main Extension Rules

rules.title: Industrial wastewater characterization
rules.requirement: Identify processes, raw materials, chemicals, pollutants, flow, batch discharges, variability, sampling data, and categorical or significant-industrial-user status.
rules.citation: KC Water Industrial Pretreatment Program; Chapter 60

question.label: Describe every non-domestic wastewater source, process chemical, expected pollutant, and maximum discharge rate.

rules.title: Applicable discharge limits
rules.requirement: Compare expected and sampled discharges with prohibited-discharge, local, categorical, and permit-specific limits and identify required controls.
rules.citation: KC Water Industrial Pretreatment Program; Chapter 60

rules.title: Pretreatment and monitoring design
rules.requirement: Provide process flow, treatment equipment, containment, sampling point, flow measurement, alarms, bypass prevention, spill response, sludge disposal, and operation plan.
rules.citation: KC Water Industrial Pretreatment Program; Chapter 60

rules.title: Complete discharge-permit application
rules.requirement: Provide owner/operator, facility, process, production, discharge, treatment, certification, and responsible-official information required by KC Water.
rules.citation: KC Water Industrial Pretreatment Program

rules.title: Process, plumbing, and discharge consistency
rules.requirement: Processes, fixtures, drains, interceptors, treatment, sampling, chemicals, and flows must agree across pretreatment, plumbing, mechanical, environmental, and sewer documents.
rules.citation: KC Water Industrial Pretreatment Program; IB110 Part A coordination

rules.title: Approval, monitoring, and reporting before discharge
rules.requirement: Obtain written authorization, complete required construction or startup inspection, and implement sampling, records, reporting, and notification duties before regulated discharge.
rules.citation: KC Water Industrial Pretreatment Program; Chapter 60

rules.title: Building-permit scope and exemptions
rules.requirement: Classify all construction, alteration, repair, change of use, demolition-interface, and site work and document any claimed exemption without treating exempt work as exempt from applicable codes.
rules.citation: KCMO Building Permit Exempt Work; Chapter 18

rules.title: Complete building-code analysis
rules.requirement: State adopted codes, occupancy groups, construction type, allowable area and height, mixed-use method, fire areas, frontage, sprinklers, occupant loads, egress, accessibility, plumbing fixtures, energy path, and special inspections.
rules.citation: IB110 Part C; Chapter 18; IB171 Commercial

rules.title: Life-safety plan compliance
rules.requirement: Verify occupancy, occupant load, exits, travel distance, common path, dead ends, exit capacity, separation, rated construction, opening protection, emergency systems, and signage against the adopted code analysis.
rules.citation: IB110 Parts B-C; Chapters 18 and 26

rules.title: Accessibility compliance
rules.requirement: Verify accessible route, site arrival, entrances, parking, doors, circulation, elevators, rooms, toilet facilities, counters, controls, dwelling or sleeping units, and signage.
rules.citation: IB110 Parts B-C and adopted accessibility standards

rules.title: Structural design package
rules.requirement: Provide design criteria, loads, geotechnical information, foundation and framing plans, calculations, lateral system, connections, delegated items, and special-inspection statement.
rules.citation: IB110 Parts A and C; Chapter 18

rules.title: MEP and fire-system coordination
rules.requirement: Verify mechanical, electrical, plumbing, gas, energy, smoke control, fire alarm, suppression, vertical transportation, and equipment-support designs agree with the architectural and structural set.
rules.citation: IB110 Parts A and C

rules.title: Zoning, site, and public approvals resolved
rules.requirement: Verify zoning, development-plan, historic, subdivision, floodplain, site disturbance, utilities, public infrastructure, and related agency approvals match the building plans.
rules.citation: IB110 Part B reviewing agencies; Chapter 88

rules.title: Related records and issuance holds
rules.requirement: Resolve required related permits, plan-review comments, fees, contractor records, deferred-submittal holds, and agency approvals before issuance or construction beyond an approved partial permit.
rules.citation: IB110 Part A; IB123; CompassKC workflow

rules.title: Correct partial or conditional permit route
rules.requirement: Determine whether the requested early work qualifies for a partial building permit and define the exact limits; approval does not authorize work outside those limits.
rules.citation: IB123 Partial and Conditional Building Permits; Chapter 18

question.label: Describe the exact excavation, footing, foundation, underground, or structural work requested before the full building permit.

rules.title: Owner proceeds at risk acknowledgment
rules.requirement: Provide the required owner acknowledgment that early work proceeds at risk and may require modification or removal based on final review.
rules.citation: IB123

rules.title: Approved early-start drawings and calculations
rules.requirement: Provide sealed foundation, structural, geotechnical, excavation, utility, and applicable site documents sufficient to review the limited scope independently.
rules.citation: IB123; IB110 Parts A and C

rules.title: Prerequisite zoning and site approvals
rules.requirement: Resolve controlling zoning, development plan, floodplain, land disturbance, utilities, shoring, and public-infrastructure approvals needed for the early work.
rules.citation: IB123; IB110 Part B

rules.title: Early work matches pending full design
rules.requirement: Footprints, grids, elevations, loads, foundations, pits, sleeves, embeds, utilities, fire service, and future construction interfaces must agree with the latest coordinated full-building design.
rules.citation: IB123; IB110 Part A coordination

rules.title: Construction and inspection limits enforced
rules.requirement: Identify authorized inspections and stop points and prevent vertical or out-of-scope work until the corresponding full or subsequent partial permit is issued.
rules.citation: IB123; Chapter 18

rules.title: Excavation-support scope and adjacent risk
rules.requirement: Identify excavation depth, soil and groundwater conditions, property-line proximity, adjacent structures and utilities, surcharge, underpinning, tiebacks, and public-right-of-way impacts.
rules.citation: Chapter 18 adopted building code; IB107 excavation-support guidance

question.label: Will shoring, tiebacks, underpinning, or excavation support extend onto or protect neighboring property or public right-of-way?

rules.title: Geotechnical investigation and recommendations

rules.title: COA before exterior building permit
rules.requirement: No building permit for exterior modification to a locally listed building or site may issue before the Certificate of Appropriateness.
rules.citation: IB110 Part B, Historic Preservation

rules.title: Permit drawings match COA approval
rules.requirement: Building, demolition, sign, and site drawings must match the approved COA scope, materials, conditions, and stamped exhibits; deviations require historic review.
rules.citation: KCMO Historic Preservation approval and IB110 Part B

rules.title: Historic approval conditions resolved
rules.requirement: List every Historic Preservation Commission or staff condition and show where each is satisfied in the permit documents.
rules.citation: KCMO Historic Preservation approval process

rules.title: Controlling UR ordinance and case records
rules.requirement: Retrieve the parcel-specific UR ordinance, approved preliminary plan, final development plan, amendments, conditions, and case numbers.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 planned-development procedures; KCMO Development Process Guide

rules.title: Current approved development plan
rules.requirement: Verify the cited plan is the latest approved plan for the parcel and has not expired, been superseded, or been amended.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 development-plan approval procedures

rules.title: Use matches UR approval
rules.requirement: The proposed use and occupancy must be authorized by the controlling UR plan and ordinance.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 UR district and approved-plan controls

rules.title: Site design matches UR plan
rules.requirement: Compare building footprint, height, setbacks, density, FAR, access, parking, loading, landscaping, utilities, phasing, and public improvements with the approved UR plan.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 UR controls; IB110 Part B Development Management review

rules.title: All UR conditions addressed
rules.requirement: Create a condition-by-condition matrix showing where each ordinance and plan condition is satisfied.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 approval conditions

rules.title: Amendment required for deviations
rules.requirement: If any proposed use, dimensional value, circulation element, phase, public improvement, or condition differs from the controlling approval, identify and complete the required plan amendment before dependent permits.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 development-plan amendment procedures

question.label: Does the current approved UR final plan cover the exact proposed work without deviation?

rules.title: UR values consistent across permit set
rules.requirement: UR case number, use, height, setbacks, site layout, access, and conditions must agree across the application, site plan, architectural plans, civil plans, and zoning sheets.
rules.citation: IB110 Part A plan coordination; Chapter 88

rules.title: Correct subdivision procedure
rules.requirement: Determine whether the proposal requires a preliminary plat, final plat, minor subdivision, lot split, lot-line adjustment, lot consolidation, or condominium plat.
rules.citation: KCMO Subdivision Process; Chapter 88 sec. 88-535

rules.title: Boundary survey and legal descriptions
rules.requirement: Provide the current boundary survey, existing and proposed legal descriptions, monuments, easements, rights-of-way, encumbrances, and closure information prepared by the appropriate Missouri professional.
rules.citation: KCMO subdivision submittal requirements; Chapter 88

rules.title: Parcel and lot-line reconciliation
rules.requirement: Existing parcel boundaries, platted lots, ownership, deed descriptions, tax parcels, and proposed lot lines must reconcile without gaps, overlaps, or structures crossing retained lines.
rules.citation: KCMO Subdivision Process and Chapter 88 subdivision standards

rules.title: Required infrastructure and easements
rules.requirement: Show and secure required street, sidewalk, utility, drainage, sewer, water, access, and temporary construction easements and the corresponding approved infrastructure plans.
rules.citation: KCMO Development Process Guide; IB159; KC Water checklists

rules.title: Resulting lots comply with zoning
rules.requirement: Each resulting lot must satisfy applicable use, dimensional, access, frontage, and approved-plan requirements or identify the required variance or plan amendment.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 subdivision and zoning standards

rules.title: Approval, signatures, and recording
rules.requirement: Verify required city approvals, owner and professional signatures, taxes and fees, dedications, and county recording before relying on the new lots for dependent permits.
rules.citation: KCMO Subdivision Process; Chapter 88

rules.title: Total disturbance area
rules.requirement: Calculate all clearing, grading, excavation, fill, stockpile, utility, staging, and common-plan disturbance and show the same total on local, state, and building records.
rules.citation: Chapter 63; Missouri DNR construction land disturbance; IB110 Part A

question.label: How many acres will be disturbed across the entire common plan of development?

rules.title: Erosion and sediment-control plan
rules.requirement: Provide existing/proposed contours, drainage, limits of disturbance, phased BMPs, stabilization, inlet protection, construction entrance, stockpile and concrete-washout controls, and responsible-party information.
rules.citation: Chapter 63; IB159; Missouri DNR SWPPP requirements

rules.title: State stormwater permit dependency
rules.requirement: If one acre or more is disturbed, including a smaller phase of a larger common plan, obtain the Missouri construction stormwater permit and SWPPP before disturbance.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR threshold; IB110 Part A, pp. 3-4

rules.title: Site-disturbance permit before building permit
rules.requirement: When the one-acre trigger applies, the local site-disturbance permit must issue before the building permit.
rules.citation: IB110 Part A, p. 4; IB123

rules.title: Stream-buffer and floodplain approvals
rules.requirement: Identify mapped stream buffers and special flood hazard areas and obtain the controlling stream-buffer or floodplain approval before affected work.
rules.citation: Chapter 88 sec. 88-415; Chapter 28; IB120

rules.title: Erosion-control inspections and stabilization
rules.requirement: Document required routine and rainfall-event inspections, correction tracking, stabilization, vegetation establishment, and final closeout.
rules.citation: KCMO Development Services inspections; Missouri DNR SWPPP obligations

rules.title: One-acre common-plan threshold
rules.requirement: Require MO-RA00000 coverage for one or more disturbed acres, including projects below one acre that are part of a common plan expected to disturb at least one cumulative acre.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR MO-RA00000 Construction or Land Disturbance Permit

rules.title: Electronic MO-RA00000 coverage
rules.requirement: Apply through Missouri's electronic permitting system and retain the issued MO-RA00000 authorization before land disturbance begins.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR MO-RA00000 electronic permitting instructions

rules.title: Site-specific SWPPP
rules.requirement: Prepare a SWPPP covering operators, disturbance, receiving waters, pollutant sources, phased BMPs, stabilization, inspection, maintenance, spill response, and records.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR MO-RA00000 SWPPP requirement

rules.title: State and local disturbance plans match
rules.requirement: Disturbance acreage, limits, phases, BMPs, drainage, responsible operators, and schedule must agree with the MO-RA00000 SWPPP and KCMO site-disturbance and building documents.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR MO-RA00000 and KCMO Chapter 63

rules.title: Correct acreage fee tier
rules.requirement: Verify the application fee uses the current disturbed-acre tier and the acreage matches the SWPPP and plans.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR MO-RA00000 permit fee schedule

rules.title: Final stabilization and termination
rules.requirement: Do not terminate MO-RA00000 coverage until final stabilization and all permit closeout conditions are documented.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR MO-RA00000 construction stormwater obligations

rules.title: Existing drainage and downstream system
rules.requirement: Show existing contours, drainage areas, discharge points, receiving systems, easements, floodplain, stream buffers, and known capacity constraints.
rules.citation: Chapter 61; KC Water stormwater standards; IB159

rules.title: Proposed drainage design and calculations
rules.requirement: Provide sealed hydrology/hydraulics, proposed drainage areas, pipe and inlet sizing, detention or BMP design, overflow routes, water-quality treatment, and construction details.
rules.citation: Chapter 61; KC Water Section 5600; IB110 Part C

rules.title: Stormwater design coordination
rules.requirement: Impervious area, grading, finished floors, roof drains, utility crossings, site disturbance, landscape BMPs, and sewer connections must agree across civil, architectural, landscape, plumbing, and erosion-control plans.
rules.citation: IB110 Parts A-C; KC Water stormwater checklists

rules.title: Drainage and BMP easements/covenants
rules.requirement: Provide required surface-drainage, storm-sewer, detention, BMP-maintenance, or stream-buffer easements and covenants using current city forms.
rules.citation: KC Water easement and covenant forms; IB159

rules.title: Permanent maintenance responsibility
rules.requirement: Identify the owner and inspection/maintenance obligations for private detention, BMP, and drainage facilities.
rules.citation: Chapter 61 and KC Water maintenance covenants

rules.title: Stormwater approval before dependent construction
rules.requirement: Resolve stormwater review, easements, and required public infrastructure permits before affected building or site work proceeds.
rules.citation: IB110 Part A; KCMO Major Infrastructure process

rules.title: Utility purpose and conflicts
rules.requirement: Identify the utility or purpose, excavation dimensions and method, existing utility locates, clearances, crossings, bore pits, and conflict resolution.
rules.citation: KCMO excavation permit; Chapter 64

rules.title: Traffic-control dependency
rules.requirement: When excavation affects a lane, sidewalk, parking, transit, or access, provide and obtain the separate approved traffic-control record.
rules.citation: KCMO Public Works separate traffic-control permit

rules.title: Streetcar access dependency
rules.requirement: When work enters the streetcar track, overhead-contact-wire, or safety envelope, obtain Track Access approval and coordinate the approved work window.
rules.citation: KCMO Streetcar Regulations Manual; Public Works TAP

rules.title: Street plate permit when used
rules.requirement: If an excavation will be covered with street plates, obtain the separate plate permit and show plate, anchorage, ramping, and inspection details.
rules.citation: KCMO Public Works street plate permit; Chapter 64

question.label: Will street plates cover any excavation?

rules.title: Minor infrastructure route eligibility
rules.requirement: Use the minor-infrastructure route only for eligible remove-and-replace sidewalk, curb, or drive-approach work; new entrances and engineered ADA work require the appropriate review path.
rules.citation: KCMO Minor Infrastructure applicability

rules.title: Detailed quantities and drawing
rules.requirement: Provide address, detailed scope, dimensions, quantities, material, jointing, grades, limits, and a location drawing.
rules.citation: KCMO Minor Infrastructure submittal requirements

rules.title: Continuous accessible pedestrian route
rules.requirement: Verify slopes, cross-slopes, landings, detectable warnings, curb-ramp geometry, clear width, obstructions, and transitions under the approved accessibility details.
rules.citation: KCMO Minor Infrastructure; IB110 Part B accessibility standards

rules.title: Zoning approval for new driveway entrance
rules.requirement: A new or relocated driveway entrance must have zoning/site-plan approval before the right-of-way construction permit.
rules.citation: KCMO Minor Infrastructure; Chapter 88 access standards

rules.title: Parks review on boulevard or parkway
rules.requirement: If the work is on a boulevard, parkway, or adjacent to a city park, obtain Parks and Recreation review and related permits.
rules.citation: IB110 Part B, Parks and Recreation review

question.label: Is the work on a boulevard, parkway, or adjacent to a city park?

rules.title: Traffic and pedestrian control plan
rules.requirement: Show lane, sidewalk, parking, loading, transit, bicycle, driveway, emergency, and pedestrian impacts with devices, detours, tapers, signs, barriers, and accessible routes.
rules.citation: KCMO traffic-control permit; Chapter 64

rules.title: Approved dates and work hours
rules.requirement: Requested closure dates, daily hours, phases, and restoration/opening times must agree across the permit, contractor schedule, and related permits.
rules.citation: KCMO Public Works permit application

rules.title: Required access maintained
rules.requirement: Maintain approved emergency, ADA, property, business, delivery, transit, and utility access or document the approved alternative.
rules.citation: Chapter 64 and Public Works permit conditions

rules.title: Required stakeholder coordination
rules.requirement: Document required coordination or notice to affected properties, transit, emergency services, streetcar, utilities, and city operations.
rules.citation: KCMO Public Works and Streetcar coordination requirements

rules.title: Streetcar safety-envelope impact
rules.requirement: Identify whether workers, equipment, cranes, scaffolding, deliveries, excavation, water services, or traffic control enter or affect the track, platform, overhead-contact-wire, or defined safety envelope.
rules.citation: KCMO Streetcar Regulations Manual and Track Access page

rules.title: Complete Track Access package
rules.requirement: Provide the work plan, exact location, dates, responsible parties, equipment, clearances, traffic control, utility conflicts, emergency contacts, and requested operating restrictions.
rules.citation: KCMO Streetcar Regulations Manual, permit submittal requirements

rules.title: Overhead electrical clearances and de-energization
rules.requirement: Verify equipment and personnel clearances to the overhead contact system and document any required isolation, de-energization, grounding, or streetcar representative.
rules.citation: KCMO Streetcar Regulations Manual, electrical safety

rules.title: Crane and lifting coordination
rules.requirement: Crane location, setup, swing, load path, height, outriggers, exclusion zone, and overhead-wire clearances must agree with the crane, ROW, and Track Access plans.
rules.citation: KCMO Streetcar Regulations Manual; Chapter 18 construction safety

rules.title: Related traffic-control approval
rules.requirement: Obtain and cross-reference the approved traffic-control permit when streetcar access affects lanes, sidewalks, platforms, or operations.
rules.citation: KCMO Streetcar Regulations Manual; Public Works permits

rules.title: Approved access window and streetcar coordination
rules.requirement: Work may occur only in the approved access window and under all required streetcar coordination, protection, inspection, and restoration conditions.
rules.citation: KCMO Streetcar Regulations Manual, work authorization

rules.title: Property-line and ROW encroachment survey
rules.requirement: Show surveyed property and ROW lines and dimension every canopy, awning, vault, areaway, tieback, foundation, sign, or other encroachment horizontally and vertically.
rules.citation: Chapter 64; KCMO Development Process Guide

rules.title: Sealed structural and waterproofing details
rules.requirement: Provide sealed structural capacity, attachment, support, waterproofing, drainage, utility-clearance, access, and restoration details applicable to the encroachment.
rules.citation: Chapter 18; IB110 Part A professional design requirements

rules.title: Clear pedestrian and ADA route
rules.requirement: Verify the encroachment preserves required sidewalk clear width, accessibility, sight distance, street trees, utilities, and public safety.
rules.citation: Chapter 64; IB110 Part B accessibility

rules.title: Required agreement, insurance, and owner authorization
rules.requirement: Provide the required encroachment agreement or license, owner authorization, insurance, indemnity, maintenance responsibility, and recording when directed.
rules.citation: Chapter 64 and Public Works permit conditions

rules.title: Vehicle and load configuration
rules.requirement: Provide vehicle, axle, gross weight, dimensions, load description, overhang, turning needs, and supporting equipment.
rules.citation: KCMO hauling and oversized-hauling permits; Chapter 64

rules.title: Approved route and clearance review
rules.requirement: Show the proposed route and verify bridge/road limits, overhead and lateral clearances, turning movements, construction zones, streetcar, and restricted facilities.
rules.citation: KCMO Public Works hauling permits; Streetcar Regulations Manual

rules.title: Approved movement date, time, and escorts
rules.requirement: Permit dates, movement window, weather limits, escorts, traffic control, and agency coordination must match the transportation plan.
rules.citation: KCMO Public Works hauling permit conditions

rules.title: Construction logistics consistency
rules.requirement: Delivery and hauling assumptions must agree with the crane plan, traffic-control plan, streetcar access, staging plan, and construction schedule.
rules.citation: KCMO Public Works permits; IB110 plan coordination

rules.title: Sealed crane and setup plan
rules.requirement: Provide crane type/configuration, capacity charts, maximum loads, setup, foundation or mat design, outriggers, swing radius, height, boom/jib, erection/dismantling, and exclusion zones.
rules.citation: Chapter 18 construction safety; IB110 professional design

rules.title: Ground-bearing and support verification
rules.requirement: Verify geotechnical capacity, underground utilities and structures, vaults, shoring, slopes, outrigger reactions, mats, and support design.
rules.citation: Chapter 18; IB110 Part A soils and structural calculations

rules.title: Airport and FAA height review
rules.requirement: Determine whether crane height and location trigger airport zoning or FAA notice/approval and retain the determination.
rules.citation: IB110 Part B, Department of Aviation review

question.label: What is the crane's maximum erected height?

rules.title: ROW occupancy and traffic approvals
rules.requirement: Obtain traffic-control, lane/sidewalk closure, parking, and encroachment approvals for crane setup, outriggers, assembly, deliveries, and swing over public property.
rules.citation: KCMO Public Works permits; Chapter 64

rules.title: Streetcar Track Access when affected
rules.requirement: If the crane or work zone affects the streetcar safety envelope or overhead wires, obtain TAP and comply with approved electrical and operating controls.
rules.citation: KCMO Streetcar Regulations Manual

rules.title: Power-line and utility clearances
rules.requirement: Show required clearances, de-energization or protection for electrical lines, streetcar wires, communications, and other utilities.
rules.citation: Chapter 18 construction safety; Streetcar Regulations Manual

rules.title: Dust and emissions source inventory
rules.requirement: Identify clearing, grading, demolition, crushing, concrete/asphalt, aggregate handling, hauling, generators, coating, or other emission-generating activities and equipment.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR air permits; IB110 Part B Air Quality; Chapter 8

rules.title: Air construction permit determination
rules.requirement: Quantify potential emissions and document whether city or state construction-permit thresholds, de minimis levels, or specific source rules apply.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR Air-related Permits; IB110 Part B; Chapter 8

question.label: Will the project install or modify equipment or processes that emit regulated air pollutants?

rules.title: Fugitive-dust control plan
rules.requirement: Document watering, stabilization, track-out control, covered loads, speed limits, stockpile control, cleanup, monitoring, complaint response, and responsible personnel.
rules.citation: KCMO Chapter 8 and Missouri air rules

rules.title: Air controls match construction documents
rules.requirement: Dust and emissions controls must agree with demolition, land disturbance, hauling, traffic, equipment, and construction logistics plans.
rules.citation: IB110 Part B and Missouri DNR air permitting

rules.title: Certified asbestos inspection
rules.requirement: Before regulated demolition or renovation, provide the inspection by a state-certified asbestos inspector identifying materials, locations, quantities, and condition.
rules.citation: IB107, p. 3; Missouri DNR Asbestos; Chapter 8

rules.title: Facility and project applicability determination
rules.requirement: Classify the facility and aggregated project correctly, including whether the limited residential exemption applies; do not use the exemption when multiple structures are part of one project.
rules.citation: IB107, p. 3; Missouri DNR asbestos applicability

question.label: Is this a single isolated one-family or qualifying small residential structure, with no other structures in the same project?

rules.title: Timely demolition or renovation notification
rules.requirement: Submit the required city/state demolition or renovation notification at least 10 working days before regulated work and verify dates match the demolition schedule.
rules.citation: IB107, p. 3; 40 CFR 61 Subpart M; 10 CSR 10-6.241; Chapter 8

rules.title: Regulated material quantities
rules.requirement: Reconcile inspected and affected quantities by material, location, friability, and disturbance method with the notification and abatement scope.
rules.citation: Missouri DNR asbestos notification requirements

rules.title: Certified asbestos personnel
rules.requirement: Verify required Missouri registrations/certifications for the inspector, abatement contractor, supervisors, and workers.
rules.citation: IB107 and Missouri DNR asbestos requirements

rules.title: Abatement and disposal records
rules.requirement: Provide abatement plan, clearance or completion documentation, waste shipment records, disposal facility, and evidence regulated materials were removed before demolition.
rules.citation: IB107, p. 3; Missouri DNR asbestos requirements

rules.title: Asbestos and demolition records agree
rules.requirement: Facility, structures, dates, quantities, contractors, disposal, and work boundaries must agree across inspection, notification, abatement, demolition permit, and schedule.
rules.citation: IB107 and Missouri DNR asbestos requirements

rules.title: Demolition permit applicability
rules.requirement: A demolition permit is required for every building or structure except the stated one-story detached residential accessory-building exemption below 200 square feet.

rules.title: Qualified demolition permit holder
rules.requirement: Verify Class I or II demolition contractor limits, or owner eligibility based on building stories and property-line distances, with required insurance.
rules.citation: IB107, p. 1; Chapter 18 sec. 18-327

rules.title: Complete demolition application package
rules.requirement: Provide address/legal description, disposal sites, utility disconnects, rat abatement, ownership/authorization, contractor license and insurance, schedule, method, and applicable related permits.

rules.title: Demolition and ROW-protection plan
rules.requirement: Show structure location, property-line distances, sidewalks/streets/alleys, height, stories, floor area, demolition sequence, and public protection, or provide the eligible pre-demolition inspection report.
rules.citation: IB107, p. 2; adopted IBC Chapter 33

rules.title: Utilities disconnected and sewer capped
rules.requirement: Verify all utilities are disconnected and document the required sewer cap/plug location and inspection before backfill.
rules.citation: IB107, pp. 1 and 3; KC Water service rules

rules.title: Historic demolition approval
rules.requirement: If the property is on the Kansas City Register, obtain the Certificate of Appropriateness for demolition before permit issuance.

rules.title: Asbestos inspection and notification complete
rules.requirement: Resolve asbestos inspection, notification, abatement, certified personnel, and disposal requirements before demolition.
rules.citation: IB107, p. 3; Missouri DNR Asbestos

rules.title: Geotechnical and structural support where triggered
rules.requirement: Provide sealed soils report and structural calculations for steep cut slopes, retained foundation walls, temporary shoring, surcharge, or close property-line conditions unless a documented IB107 exception applies.

question.label: Will demolition leave an excavation, steep cut, retained foundation wall, or temporary support condition?

rules.title: Street closure, hauling, blasting, and nighttime permits
rules.requirement: Obtain every applicable street closure, hauling, blasting, and special nighttime construction permit and cross-reference approved dates.
rules.citation: IB107, pp. 1-2; IB154; Public Works permits

rules.title: Required demolition inspections
rules.requirement: Schedule and pass public ROW protection, basement/open-hole, final, and any required periodic or special inspections in the prescribed sequence.

rules.title: Final grading and clean site
rules.requirement: After material removal and open-hole approval, fill and grade the site to surrounding contours, use clean earth at the surface, and leave the site clean for final inspection.
rules.citation: IB107, pp. 1 and 3
